messages:
elaine: dropped a prototype exploring 'staged lanes' for approvals: you can approve a small canary subset, then promote to full. Want quick UX + copy sanity check before I spec it. link: https://figma.com/file/staged-lanes (WIP)
ryan: neat. immediate ask: how do we present the canary size? slider? percent input? prefer explicit buttons: 1%, 5%, 10% + custom field for compactness.
mina: copy nit: don't call it 'canary' in product UI for non-eng teams. Maybe 'Pilot' or 'Staged rollout'. Use 'Pilot approve' as label.
elaine: agree on 'Pilot approve'. we'll use 'Pilot: 5 runs' and a secondary 'Promote to all' CTA after pilot completes.
chuck: accessibility: ensure keyboard flow for pilot size control. The preset buttons need aria-pressed states and custom field must have aria-label and validation text.
ophelia: UX question: during pilot, show an inline progress row and an unobtrusive toast: 'Pilot running: 5 / 5 completed'. Make the toast role=Status and tabbable for Undo? probably not, but we need undo after promote.
docs-bot: Doc suggestion: add a short help blurb linking to the rollback guide: https://kb.redwood.ai/rollback (internal).
mina: microcopy: top-level CTA — we've had debates: 'Approve runs' vs 'Sign off' vs 'Mark reviewed'. For staged lanes I'd use 'Pilot approve' then 'Approve runs' when promoting. Keeps context.
ryan: also add a confidence slider in the pilot modal? e.g., require a minimum average score or threshold to auto-promote. Could be confusing but useful for power users.
ophelia: if we add confidence threshold, make it optional and default off. Expose it in advanced settings with tooltip and aria-describedby.
elaine: typo fix: (internal) -> I'll update.
ux-signal: Suggestion: When promoting, add an audit modal summarizing which tests changed and a one-click revert for 24h. Provide keyboard-accessible 'Revert' in audit history.
chuck: accessibility: animations for pilot progress must respect prefers-reduced-motion and progress announcements should be conveyed in aria-live polite.
mina: small visual hint: when a test in the pilot shows a score drop > threshold, flag with a red dot + text 'Needs attention' rather than using only color.
elaine: action items: 1) rename 'canary' -> 'Pilot', 2) add preset pilot sizes + custom, 3) optional confidence threshold (advanced), 4) pilot progress toast + aria-live, 5) promote flow with audit + 24h revert, 6) accessibility annotations for controls. I'll update figma and ping for final review. :thumbsup:
